scope: Frozen RL/probability knowledge delta: public file/SQLite top-3 nonregression across seven existing suites, two new paper queries, eight reuse/refusal decisions, prompt cursor contract and Linux unittest execution. Not model quality, paper reproduction, GPU speed or a scientific proof.

implementation.procedure: Read actual search/reuse and new cards; inspect cursor text and exact executed sources.
implementation.acceptance: Fresh replay matches current file/SQLite and saved prompt obeys next_domain.

reference_boundary.procedure: Reconstruct expected IDs and all four decision conditions per paper.
reference_boundary.acceptance: New queries hit both cards in top3; missing/changed/explicit reproduction never authorize skipping.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind actual corpus/code/config/logs/environment; compare old/current query IDs, denominators and failures.
data_integrity.acceptance: Seven suite inputs identical; all rows accounted for; no concealed failing command or mixed source.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute unitless recalls and require monotonic old-query recall with no-hit preservation.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: No worse prior query; new target recall 1; finite counts with nonempty denominators.

measurement_validity.procedure: Identify development-query and unit-test scope; no time/performance or paper-data comparison.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Timing N/A; authored checks cannot certify model quality or general speed.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent host process rebuilds SQLite and replays fresh retrieval/decision checks.
reproducibility.acceptance: Same current frozen source, actual target hits/refusals and all bounded regression commands exit0.
